title: Localized tensor pullback composition counit pasting
statement: For scheme morphisms f:X→Y, g:Y→Z [def-pc-scheme] and a homotopy complex K of O_X-modules with the derived categories fixed [def-pc-derived-category], use the selected tensor pullback adjunctions a(s) [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and their homotopy adjunctions b(s), and the selected left-derived counits epsilon(s) [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Put M=U(fg)K and c=(conjugateIsoEquiv a(fg) (a(g).comp a(f))).symm(pushforwardComp f g).symm. Then Lf(epsilon(g)_M), epsilon(f) at P_g M, Q(c_M), and Q(b(fg).counit_K), pasted in order, equal the concrete derivedCompositionCounitApex f g K [def-sc-derived-composition-counit-apex]. Only f and g derived pullbacks and counits occur in this formula: there is no L(fg), no derived (fg)-adjunction counit, no right-derived unit and no derived composition comparison. This is exactly the localized underived counit/naturality step of the parent argument.

source.place: Stacks Project Tags 0096 and 0097: tensor pullback adjunction and composition of direct images; Tag 079W: localization of adjunction identities. Official tag pages read online on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: The mate counit identity conjugateEquiv_counit_symm identifies c followed by the composite-morphism counit with the composite adjunction counit after pullback of pushforwardComp.inv. Its components are identities on sections, so the pullback map is an identity and comp_counit_app gives the two pasted counits.
On a representative complex apply this equation at every degree. The comparison and adjunction counits are defined degreewise, so extensionality gives equality of complex maps.

Apply the homotopy quotient, use preservation of composition and the quotient descriptions of mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso and the induced counits. Every homotopy complex has a representative, so the equation holds for all K.

Apply localization Q_X to the homotopy counit identity. Naturality of the selected epsilon(f) at b(g).counit_H moves its localized image into Lf. Functoriality combines it with epsilon(g). The strict composite direct-image object is U(g)(U(f)K). The construction equation derivedCompositionCounitApex_eq identifies the resulting morphism with the apex. No composite derived adjunction, right-derived unit or derived comparison is used.

proof_origin.note: Isolates the underived mate/homotopy identity and its localization/naturality, stated at the existing concrete apex interface. The parent proves the pinned derived Hom normalization and left-derived lift factorization.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorPullbackComposition_localized_homotopy_counit
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    let epsilon {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) :=
      (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) s
    let a {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) :=
      Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction s)
    let b {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) :=
      (a s).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv (a (f ≫ g)) ((a g).comp (a f))).symm
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).symm
    let M := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ≫ g)).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
    ((derivedPullback f).map ((epsilon g).app M) ≫
      (epsilon f).app
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map
        ((Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso c (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app M)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).map
        ((b (f ≫ g)).counit.app K) = derivedCompositionCounitApex f g K
